tagline.en: An MIT-licensed 7B vision-language-action policy — a strong open baseline for robot control.
tagline.zh: MIT 许可的 7B 视觉-语言-动作策略——机器人控制的开放强基线。

en: OpenVLA is an open vision-language-action (VLA) policy: a 7B model that takes camera images plus a language instruction and predicts robot actions. It's a widely-used open baseline for generalist robot manipulation, released under the MIT license.

WorldFoundry offers the base openvla-7b checkpoint and a LIBERO-10 fine-tuned variant. The runtime vendors the Prismatic/OpenVLA architecture code in-tree, so imports don't depend on external repos or remote code, and it emits an action-trace artifact rather than video.
In WorldFoundry you run the action-prediction or policy-rollout route on the base checkpoint by default; pass unnorm_key=libero_10 to switch to the LIBERO-10 fine-tune.
zh: OpenVLA 是一个开放的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略：一个 7B 模型，接收相机图像加语言指令，预测机器人动作。它是被广泛使用的通用机器人操作开放基线，采用 MIT 许可。
WorldFoundry 提供基础的 openvla-7b checkpoint 与一个在 LIBERO-10 上微调的变体。其运行时把 Prismatic/OpenVLA 架构代码内置于代码库，导入不依赖外部仓库或远程代码，输出的是动作轨迹产物而非视频。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你默认在基础 checkpoint 上运行动作预测或 policy-rollout 路径；传入 unnorm_key=libero_10 即可切换到 LIBERO-10 微调版本。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a well-known, openly-licensed VLA baseline for robot manipulation — mapping images and instructions to actions, with a LIBERO-10 fine-tune ready to go.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个知名、开放许可的 VLA 基线用于机器人操作时使用——把图像与指令映射为动作，并有现成的 LIBERO-10 微调版本。

notFor.en: Not a video or image generator — its output is action traces, and it's kept out of video-generation scorecards. At 7B it needs adequate GPU memory to run.
notFor.zh: 它不是视频或图像生成器——输出为动作轨迹，且不进入视频生成的评分体系。作为 7B 模型，运行需要足够的 GPU 显存。

In-tree architecture, no remote code dependency
